description.value: RisingWave is a streaming data platform that ingests, processes and serves real-time data to AI agents, applications and analytics; it calls itself 'Streaming Infrastructure for Agentic AI'.
RisingWave Labs is a San Francisco database company whose main product is an open-source streaming database.

product_description.value: RisingWave Ultra (in-memory stream processing for sub-100ms workloads); Open Lake (managed Apache Iceberg tables powered by Apache DataFusion); Low-Latency Serving (row storage for live data); cloud and self-managed deployment options.
Open-source distributed streaming database written in Rust, built on standard SQL, with native Apache Iceberg integration; RisingWave Cloud is the managed offering.

business_model_description.value: The core engine is open source under the Apache 2.0 license; RisingWave Cloud is a managed service with enterprise features, with a 'Start Free' trial and a 'Talk to Sales' option.
Pattern of a free open-source core plus a paid managed cloud service, with a Forever-Free Developer Tier introduced in 2024; this is inferred from the sources, not a stated pricing model.

customer_description.value: Claims 1,000+ organizations; logos include PepsiCo, Siemens, Robinhood, Tencent, Booksy and OpenSea; industry solutions cover financial services, energy, manufacturing, sports betting, logistics, ad tech, e-commerce and healthcare.
Enterprises across financial services, e-commerce, advertising technology, manufacturing and logistics, for use cases such as trading and risk systems and IoT telemetry.

founded_year.value: Founded in January 2021 (one source); most sources date the company to 2021.

headquarters.value: San Francisco, California (one directory lists 95 3rd Street, 2nd Floor)
